plugins.label: inflak Main
plugins.description: Dialogue-first image creation, intelligent editing, reusable asset extraction, and text writing with adaptive task-specific interactions.

plugins.label: inflak Author
plugins.description: Conversationally design, preview, validate, and publish a new four-layer inflak plugin from a non-technical description of the intended human-AI collaboration.

plugins.label: inflak P1 User-Driven Prompt Refinement
plugins.description: P1 paradigm: the user selects parts of a drafted image prompt for GenAI to extend, steer, or restyle; the prompt is the object of every interaction, and the image is generated once confirmed.

plugins.label: inflak P2 User-Driven Prompt Organization
plugins.description: P2 paradigm: the user reviews and organizes traceable prompt units derived from their own visual instruction; the confirmed single-image or multi-scene structure is compiled without erasing user wording.

plugins.label: inflak P3 Interaction as Part of Instruction
plugins.description: P3 paradigm: a user draws a color-to-object layout sketch, confirms the compiled spatial brief, and uses it with a prompt to generate an image.

plugins.label: inflak P4 Referenced Artifact as Instruction
plugins.description: P4 paradigm: the user directly marks a local region of an existing image artifact, combines it with an inpaint instruction, and reviews the generated edit.

plugins.label: inflak P5 AI-Driven Prompt Suggestion
plugins.description: P5 paradigm: GenAI expands a writer's seed idea into distinct narrative directions, then the writer selects and focuses them into a confirmed prompt before generating text.

plugins.label: inflak P6 AI-Driven Prompt Decomposition
plugins.description: P6 paradigm: GenAI decomposes a source prompt into traceable, fine-grained components that the user can organize and edit on a Canvas before generating a downloadable story.

plugins.label: inflak P7 Generative Prompt Control Widgets
plugins.description: P7 paradigm: GenAI identifies controllable image-prompt units, then users adjust semantic priority, composition, candidate preferences, and supported prompt weights through embedded controls before generation.

plugins.label: inflak P8 Generative Artifact Control Widgets
plugins.description: P8 artifact-grounded paradigm with a persistent upload-first Canvas replacing the conversation surface.

plugins.label: inflak P9 Artifact to Structured Instruction
plugins.description: P9 grounds an analysis request in an uploaded chart or table, links recommendations to source data, and has the active Host Agent generate a structured evidence-backed report.

plugins.label: inflak P10 Artifact to Multimodal Instruction
plugins.description: P10 analyzes an SVG artifact without a user prompt, generates object-grounded refinement suggestions, collects anchored decisions, and exports an Augmented Instruction.

plugins.label: inflak P11 Artifact-Driven Prompt Enhancement
plugins.description: P11 grounds an existing user prompt in a stable SVG artifact, resolves ambiguous targets and actions through object-anchored interaction, then exports a confirmed enhanced prompt.

plugins.label: inflak P12 Interactive Artifact Refinement
plugins.description: P12 grounds a refinement prompt in a layered SVG collage, collects post-GenAI artifact interactions, and commits confirmed changes as new artifact revisions without producing an Augmented Instruction.

plugins.label: inflak Collage Authoring
plugins.description: Unified SVG creation, artifact analysis, prompt grounding, recommendation, authoring, and revision workflow backed by one four-layer task and shared typed tools.

plugins.label: inflak P13 AI-Proactively-Initiated Interaction
plugins.description: P13 infers any user intent from the current turn and conversation context, then presents one evidence-backed best recommendation with feasible alternatives for user selection without executing it.

plugins.label: Daily Paper Conclusion Assistant
plugins.description: Create an evidence-linked daily digest from recent public arXiv cs.HC papers.
